explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/455: Richter proved liminf q_n/n² > 0.352⋯ for increasing primes with non-decreasing gaps. The statement takes a strictly increasing prime sequence with q(n+2) − q(n+1) ≥ q(n+1) − q(n) (0-indexed; the shift does not change the liminf, since (n+1)²/n² → 1) and asserts that the ℝ≥0∞ liminf of q n/n² exceeds 0.352. That is implied by Richter's bound. Faithful.
